description: Colonnine di ricarica is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datigis.comune.fi.it. The dataset contains the point elements that represent the geolocation of the charging stations for electric vehicles in the Municipality of Florence. The data may be out of date. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Charging columns" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ricarica, colonnine, open data, mezzi elettrici, mobilità. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
